wireContract: The authenticated community HNS import read exposes optional attachment.binding_generation as a positive safe integer. The server supplies the canonical route binding generation, independently of import-session revision, for existing owner-recovery commands. Older responses remain valid; recovery clients must not infer a generation when it is absent. Existing endpoints are unchanged.
